name: 비디오 디노이징 트레이스 분석
description: Detects traces of denoising applied to deepfake videos to mask generation artifacts.
mechanism:
This method detects denoising traces for video forensic analysis:

1. **노이즈Level추정**: The noise level and noise model of the video are estimated per frame. This establishes the baseline expected noise characteristics for the imaging pipeline.

2. **DenoisingSignature감지**: Denoising algorithms leave characteristic signatures: (a) selective frequency attenuation (noise reduction in high frequencies while preserving edges), (b) stair-casing artifacts (from total variation denoising), (c) hallucinated details (from neural network denoising). The method identifies these signatures.

3. **SelectiveDenoising감지**: The method checks whether denoising has been selectively applied to specific regions. Authentic video is either entirely denoised or not at all. Selective denoising (face denoised but background not) indicates targeted processing — potentially part of a deepfake pipeline's post-processing.

4. **Denoising-해상도일관성**: Denoising affects the effective resolution of the image (removing high-frequency noise also removes some high-frequency detail). The method checks whether denoised regions show consistent effective resolution with non-denoised regions. Resolution mismatches reveal processing different regions with different denoising parameters.

5. **Multi-PassDenoising감지**: Multiple denoising passes produce cumulative signatures — progressive loss of fine detail. The method detects evidence of multiple denoising steps, consistent with a deepfake pipeline: generator output → denoising → blending → additional denoising to smooth blending artifacts.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
